rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: De 12-matenblues in A, de quick change, een boogiebaslijn, de turnaround en je eerste blueslicks.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary

rows.source: The blues in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title

rows.source: One, four, five
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Bluesakkoorden liggen op de eerste, vierde en vijfde toon van de toonsoort. In E zijn dat E7, A7 en B7. Ga je naar A, dan worden het A7, D7 en E7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Welk akkoord doet in A wat B7 in E deed?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 ligt vijf nootletters boven E. Vijf nootletters boven A ligt E, dus E7 neemt zijn plaats in.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Twelve bars in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Vier maten A7, twee D7, twee A7 en dan elk één maat E7, D7, A7 en E7. De laatste E7 leidt je terug naar het begin.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The quick change
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title

rows.source: Visit the four chord early
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Bij een quick change springt maat 2 naar het IV-akkoord en meteen terug. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. Zo komt er vanaf het begin beweging in.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Welk akkoord staat in maat 2 bij een quick change in A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Het IV-akkoord in A is D7. De quick change gaat er in maat 2 heen en keert dan terug naar A7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now in E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: De quick change werkt in elke toonsoort. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Let tegen het einde op B7, je akkoord met vier vingers.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A boogie bass line
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · title

rows.source: Walk the chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Een boogielijn loopt door het akkoord omhoog en terug, elke noot tweemaal, lang-kort als de shuffle. Over A7 stijgt hij via A, C-kruis, E, F-kruis, G en gaat dan weer omlaag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Open A, fret 4 op snaar 5, fret 2 en 4 op snaar 4, dan open G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Hoe voelen de twee noten van elk paar?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Exactly even
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Weer de shuffle: een lange noot op de tel, een korte vlak voor de volgende.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Move it to D and E
rows.translation: Verplaats het naar D en E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Dezelfde loop begint op D op snaar 4 en op E op snaar 6. Over D7: D, F-kruis, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G-kruis, B, C-kruis, D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.translation: Boogie, van A naar D en terug
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Maat 11 en 12 krijgen vaak een turnaround: een korte lick die naar het begin leidt. Deze loopt van A naar E omlaag, één fret tegelijk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: fret 2, fret 1, then open.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Snaar 4: fret 4, dan 3, dan 2. Laat de E doorklinken.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bars 1 and 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bars 5 and 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: In de laatste twee maten. Hij leidt je oor terug naar maat 1 voor een nieuwe ronde.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Ten bars, then the lick
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Sla de eerste tien maten met de quick change aan en speel dan de lick in maat 11 en 12. Zo sluit een bluesband elke ronde af.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Blues licks in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · title

rows.source: The pentatonic meets the blues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: Je pentatonische A-mineurpatroon past precies over een blues in A. De C schuurt tegen de C-kruis in A7: dat schuren is de bluesklank.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Welke noot klinkt boven een blues in A het meest als thuis?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A is de grondtoon van de toonsoort. Licks die op A eindigen klinken afgerond; G en C laten je wachten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Call and answer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Bluesfrasen praten met elkaar. Speel lick 1 als vraag en antwoord met lick 2, die op de lage A landt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Question and answer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Blues licks, up to speed
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · title

rows.source: Funk on one chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neonwasserette is een eigen nummer van Timbre: funk op één akkoord, A7. Het motief glijdt van C naar C-kruis, dezelfde wrijving als je blueslicks, en het refrein daalt naar E7. Het hele nummer staat in Nummers, onder Eigen werk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A op fret 2 van snaar 3, dan C en C-kruis op fret 1 en 2 van snaar 2, dan open E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Welke noot schuurt tegen het A7-akkoord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C sharp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 bestaat uit A, C-kruis, E en G. C uit je pentatonische patroon schuurt tegen de C-kruis. Het motief glijdt van de ene naar de andere.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Boogie, played straight
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neonwasserette shuffelt niet. Speel je boogieloop in gelijke achtsten en hij wordt een baslijn onder A7: A, C-kruis, E, F-kruis, G en weer omlaag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Twelve bars, your way
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Niets nieuws: de 12-matenblues in A en E, de quick change, de boogielijn, de turnaround en je licks. Houd de shuffle swingend.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Welk akkoord staat in maat 2 bij een quick change in E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Boogie, all 12 bars
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Lead technique
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends en vibrato, en een tweede pentatonisch patroon.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · unit summary

rows.source: Sound a note without picking
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Bij een hammer-on klinkt een tweede noot door alleen de grijphand. Sla een noot aan en zet een andere vinger stevig neer, vlak achter een hogere fret. De snaar blijft klinken.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Sla de open snaar 3 aan en hamer vinger 2 op fret 2. Sla de tweede noot niet aan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Snaar 3: sla fret 5 met vinger 1 aan en hamer dan vinger 3 op fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
rows.translation: Wat laat een hammer-on helder klinken?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Picking both notes hard
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Snel en stevig vlak achter de fret landen
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pressing finger 1 harder
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Snelheid en precisie tellen meer dan kracht. Land op je vingertop, vlak achter de fret, en de snaar blijft zingen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hammer-ons in box 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A phrase with hammer-ons
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons in reverse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Een pull-off gaat naar een lagere noot. Zet beide vingers neer, sla de hoge noot aan en trek de bovenste vinger zijwaarts weg, zodat hij de snaar bij het loslaten tokkelt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Fret 2 op snaar 3, trek dan vinger 2 weg om open G te laten klinken.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Vinger 1 en 3 op fret 5 en 7. Sla aan en trek dan vinger 3 weg.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
rows.translation: Bij een pull-off gaat de bovenste vinger…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lifts straight up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stays down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.translation: Zijwaarts weg en tokkelt de snaar
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Recht optillen laat de noot uitdoven. Een kleine zijwaartse trek laat de lagere noot klinken.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pull-offs in box 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Hammer, then pull
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Glide to the next note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Sla voor een slide een noot aan en blijf drukken terwijl je dezelfde vinger naar een nieuwe fret schuift. De druk draagt de klank; alleen de eerste noot wordt aangeslagen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Vinger 3 op snaar 3, fret 7. Sla aan en schuif naar fret 9 zonder los te laten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Wat houdt de noot tijdens een slide klinkend?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Picking again at the end
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Steady pressure as you glide
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A lighter touch
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Laat je los, dan dooft de noot. Houd dezelfde druk tot aan de nieuwe fret.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Nu terug: sla fret 9 aan en schuif omlaag naar fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A phrase with a slide
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Slide, up to speed
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Bends and vibrato
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · title

rows.source: Bend to a target
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Bij een bend duw je de snaar over de fret om de toon te verhogen. Een bend van een hele toon, twee fretten, vanaf fret 7 moet precies als fret 9 klinken.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Snaar 3, fret 9: dit is je doeltoon voor de bend. Laat doorklinken en onthoud de klank.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Three fingers push
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Zet vinger 3 op fret 7, met vinger 1 en 2 erachter op dezelfde snaar. Duw alle drie naar het plafond en draai je pols alsof je een deurknop omdraait.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Je bend vanaf fret 7 klinkt lager dan fret 9. Wat nu?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Push a little further
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pick harder
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Release the bend
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: Een te lage bend klinkt vals. Duw tot de toon overeenkomt met de doeltoon die je hoorde.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: De doeltoon, dan een te kleine bend. Dezelfde noot of niet?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Same
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Different
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Vibrato makes notes sing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato is een kleine bend die je op een aangehouden noot snel herhaalt en loslaat. Houd het smal en gelijkmatig, zodat de noot zuiver blijft.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Make the long notes sing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Box 2 and the link
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · title

rows.source: A second box
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Dezelfde vijf noten herhalen zich hoger op de hals. Patroon 2 begint waar patroon 1 eindigt: vinger 1 op fret 7 van snaar 5, 4 en 3, vinger 2 op fret 8 van snaar 6, 2 en 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Snaar 6: fret 8 en 10. Snaar 5: fret 7 en 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Strings 6, 5 and 4
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which notes are in box 2?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Dezelfde vijf noten als patroon 1, A C D E G, op een nieuwe plek op de hals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Strings 3, 2 and 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: The link: slide up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Schuif vinger 3 van fret 7 naar fret 9 op snaar 3 om van patroon 1 naar patroon 2 te gaan. Je komt in patroon 2 aan met je hand al op zijn plek.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From box 1 to box 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · title

rows.source: Lead over a reggae groove
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Zoutwaterzondag is een eigen nummer van Timbre: ontspannen reggae in A-mineur, met afwisselend een maat Am7 en D7. Beide pentatonische patronen passen. Gebruik hammer-ons, pull-offs en slides en begin elke maat op een akkoordtoon. Het hele nummer staat in Nummers, onder Eigen werk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hammer and pull, in box 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Welke van deze patroontonen hoort bij D7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 bestaat uit D, F-kruis, A en C. C, de septiem, klinkt stabiel; E en G zijn slechts doorgangstonen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · title

rows.source: Phrases with feeling
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Niets nieuws: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, doeltonen voor bends, vibrato en beide patronen. Speel elke frase helder en laat die dan zingen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Een bend van een hele toon vanaf fret 7 moet klinken als…

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: De doeltoon, dan een bend. Dezelfde noot of niet?

rows.source: Moving barre chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · title

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: E- en A-grepen hoger op de hals, majeur en mineur, de dichtstbijzijnde greep en een schema in A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · unit summary

rows.source: The E shape moves
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · title

rows.source: F is only the start
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Je F-barré is een E-greep met een barré op fret 1. Schuif alles omhoog en de naam volgt de grondtoon op snaar 6: op fret 3 is het G, op fret 5 A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Een E-barrégreep op fret 5. Welk akkoord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Snaar 6 telt omhoog vanaf E: F op 1, G op 3, A op 5. De barréfret geeft het akkoord zijn naam.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Minor: lift finger 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Til vinger 2 op en laat de barré snaar 3 indrukken. Dat is de E-mineurgreep, die net zo verschuift: F-kruismineur op fret 2, A-mineur op fret 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The A shape moves
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title

rows.source: A shape, root on string 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B-mineur was een A-mineurgreep met een barré. De A-majeurgreep verschuift ook: leg een barré over snaar 1 tot 5 en vinger 3 plat over snaar 4, 3 en 2, twee fretten hoger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Een A-barrégreep op fret 3. Welk akkoord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Snaar 5 telt omhoog vanaf A: B op 2, C op 3, D op 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Gebruik voor mineur je B-mineurvingers: 2, 3 en 4 vormen het A-mineurpatroon vóór de barré. Op fret 3 is dat C-mineur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E shape or A shape?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · title

rows.source: Every chord has two homes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: De meeste akkoorden kunnen een E-greep zijn, met de grondtoon op snaar 6, of een A-greep, met de grondtoon op snaar 5. Kies de greep die het dichtst bij je hand ligt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Je speelt G op fret 3. Waar ligt de dichtstbijzijnde C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E shape at fret 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A shape at fret 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A shape at fret 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: De grondtoon van C ligt op snaar 5, fret 3. Blijf op fret 3 en wissel naar de A-greep.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
rows.translation: Houd de barré, wissel de greep
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Van G naar C op fret 3 blijft vinger 1 op de barré. Alleen de vingers ervoor veranderen. Dit is de soepelste barréwisseling.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: Op welke fret ligt D als A-greep?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Snaar 5: A open, B op 2, C op 3, D op 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · title

rows.source: A new key: A major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: F-kruismineur, D, A en E horen allemaal bij de toonsoort A. Begin met F-kruismineur als barré en de andere drie open.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Snaar 6: F op fret 1, F-kruis op fret 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now all barres
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Speel hoger op de hals: F-kruismineur op fret 2, D als A-greep op fret 5, A als E-greep op fret 5 en E als A-greep op fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Smooth barre changes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · title

rows.source: Relax between chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Laat de barré even losser terwijl je beweegt en druk aan wanneer je landt. Voortdurend hard knijpen vermoeit je hand en vertraagt de wissel.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: All the time
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only as the chord lands
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Never
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Druk om te landen, ontspan om te bewegen. Aanhoudende kracht put je hand in enkele minuten uit.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Strum through the move
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Til op de laatste opslag vóór een wissel de barré op en blijf aanslaan. De open snaren klinken even, het ritme stopt niet en je landt op tijd.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · title

rows.source: Two barres, one family
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Zonsopkomst in spuitverf is een eigen nummer van Timbre: indiepop in E op E, B, C-kruismineur en A. B en C-kruismineur zijn A-barrégrepen, twee fretten uit elkaar. Eén handvorm doet dus het meeste werk. Het hele nummer staat in Nummers, onder Eigen werk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.translation: Snaar 5 telt omhoog vanaf A: B op 2, C op 3, C-kruis op 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Barre challenge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · title

rows.source: Up and down the neck
rows.translation: Omhoog en omlaag over de hals
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.translation: Niets nieuws: E- en A-grepen, majeur en mineur, de dichtstbijzijnde greep kiezen en soepel wisselen. Ontspan tussen de akkoorden en land op tel één.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
rows.translation: Welke greep hoort bij een grondtoon op snaar 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rhythm styles
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · title

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Funkzestienden en scratches, de reggaechop, country-boom-chick en een gesyncopeerd popritme.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary

rows.source: Sixteenth notes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · title

rows.source: Four to a beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Zestiende noten verdelen elke tel in vieren: één-e-en-e, twee-e-en-e. Je aanslaghand beweegt dubbel zo snel: neer-op-neer-op binnen elke tel.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.translation: Hoeveel zestiende noten vullen één tel?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Eén-e-en-e: vier gelijke delen van elke tel.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The funk chord: E9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk houdt van het noonakkoord. Vinger 2 op snaar 5, fret 7, vinger 1 op snaar 4, fret 6 en vinger 3 plat over snaar 3, 2 en 1 op fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Funk: scratches and hits
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title

rows.source: Mute, then hit
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Houd je hand in zestienden in beweging, maar ontspan je grijpvingers zodat de meeste aanslagen droge, krassende tikken worden. Druk alleen aan voor de klinkende aanslagen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What makes a scratch?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Grijpvingers licht op de snaren laten rusten
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strumming with your palm
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plucking with your thumb
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Aanraken zonder indrukken stopt de snaarklank. De aanslag wordt een heldere, percussieve tik.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Short hits, and D9
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Druk voor elke aanslag aan en ontspan meteen, zodat de klank kort blijft. Schuif de hele E9-greep twee fretten omlaag en je hebt D9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Reggae: the offbeat chop
rows.translation: Reggae: de chop op de zwakke tel
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title

rows.source: Chop on two and four
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: De reggaegitaar antwoordt op de drums met korte, heldere akkoorden op tel twee en vier. Sla alleen de dunne snaren aan en kap elk akkoord meteen af.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Small, high shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Gebruik alleen de vier hoogste snaren. Deze A-mineur is de bovenkant van je A-mineurbarré op fret 5: vinger 3 op snaar 4, fret 7, vinger 1 als barré over de rest.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Hoe lang moet een reggaechop doorklinken?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: As long as possible
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Barely at all
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Exactly one beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Indrukken, aanslaan, loslaten. De chop is een korte blaf; de ruimte erna vormt de groove.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D, up top
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Nu de bovenkant van je D-barré: vinger 3 plat over snaar 4, 3 en 2 op fret 7, vinger 1 op snaar 1 op fret 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Country boom-chick
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title

rows.source: Bass, strum, bass, strum
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Countryritme verdeelt de maat: één basnoot op tel één en drie, een snelle aanslag over de dunne snaren op twee en vier. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The booms in G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Wat gebeurt bij boom-chick op tel twee en vier?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A single bass note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.translation: Een korte aanslag over de dunne snaren

rows.source: Nothing at all

rows.source: Alternate the bass
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Verplaats de tweede boom naar een andere snaar: in G, snaar 6 en dan snaar 4. In C, snaar 5 en dan 4. In D, snaar 4 en dan open snaar 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Booms in G, C en D

rows.source: The syncopated pop strum
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title

rows.source: Skip the downbeats
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Syncopen plaatsen de aanslag waar je hem niet verwacht. Neer op één, op op de en van twee, op op de en van drie en dan neer-op op vier.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Wat doet je hand in dit patroon op tel twee?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strums down hard
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Swings down past the strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: De slinger stopt nooit. Op twee beweegt de hand omlaag zonder te raken, klaar voor de opslag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Change a little early
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Popgitaristen wisselen vaak op de laatste opslag, de en van vier. Zo komt het nieuwe akkoord nét eerder. Dat stuwt het nummer vooruit.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Sparkler Season
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sterretjesseizoen is een eigen nummer van Timbre: een zomers meezingnummer in C op C, G, A-mineur en F. Geef het het gesyncopeerde popritme en wissel nét eerder, op de en van vier. Het hele nummer staat in Nummers, onder Eigen werk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: Open E en D op fret 3 van snaar 2, tweemaal, dan G op fret 3 van snaar 1 en terug omlaag naar D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Waarom wissel je akkoorden op de en van vier?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Zodat het nieuwe akkoord op tel één klinkt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: To slow the song down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: To skip a chord
rows.translation: Om een akkoord over te slaan
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Door op de laatste opslag te bewegen is je hand nét eerder op zijn plek, klaar voor het nieuwe akkoord op tel één.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Putting it together
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · title

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Een capo, G- en D-grepen met capo op 2 en Oh! Susanna met een couplet en refrein.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 “Putting it together” · unit summary

rows.source: The capo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · title

rows.source: A clamp across the neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Een capo klemt elke snaar op één fret vast. Op fret 2 klinkt elke open snaar twee fretten hoger en gaan al je open akkoordgrepen mee omhoog.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Vóór de capo: tokkel snaar 1 en 2 open. Dat zijn E en B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Klem de capo nu vlak achter fret 2 en tokkel weer: F-kruis en C-kruis.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Capo op fret 2. Je speelt een G-greep. Welk akkoord klinkt?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: Twee fretten boven G ligt A. De greep blijft G; de klank gaat mee omhoog met de capo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Think in shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: Met een capo denk je nog steeds aan G, C en D, de bekende grepen. De diagrammen noemen hier het akkoord dat je echt hoort: een G-greep met capo op 2 heet dus A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-1 “The capo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: G- en D-grepen met capo op 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · title

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: Met capo op 2 klinken G-, C-, D- en E-mineurgrepen als A, D, E en F-kruismineur. Dezelfde vingers, nieuwe toonsoort: A-majeur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Capo op fret 2. Een D-greep klinkt als…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: Twee fretten boven D ligt E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The D family
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: D-grepen werken net zo. Met capo op 2 klinken D-, G- en A-grepen als E, A en B: de toonsoort E met makkelijke open grepen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · lesson gtr-16-2 “G and D shapes on capo 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Oh! Susanna: the verse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · title

rows.source: Verse, then chorus
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: De meeste nummers wisselen twee delen af. Het couplet vertelt het verhaal; het refrein herhaalt het motief. Stephen Fosters Oh! Susanna (1848) heeft beide. Capo eraf: het staat in G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: De opmaat en eerste maat: open G, A op fret 2, dan open B, tweemaal D op fret 3 en open E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Welk deel keert meestal met dezelfde woorden terug?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The intro
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Coupletten veranderen van tekst terwijl het verhaal verdergaat. Het refrein komt onveranderd terug: dat zingen mensen mee.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Chords under the verse
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Begeleid het couplet met G en D7 in boom-chickstijl: bas op één, aanslag op twee. Drie maten G, één D7, twee G, dan D7 en G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The verse, flowing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: Oh! Susanna: the chorus
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · title

rows.source: The hook starts higher
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Het refrein opent op C, snaar 2, fret 1, en springt dan naar open E. De akkoorden zijn C, G en D7. De tweede helft is gelijk aan het einde van het couplet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Het begin: tweemaal C op snaar 2, fret 1, dan driemaal open E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Dan omlaag: tweemaal D, open B, open G en A op fret 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: De drie E’s gaan kort, lang, kort. Waar begint de lange?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Halfway through the beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Hij begint op de en en klinkt door over de volgende tel. Dat vooruitduwen is een syncope, net als in je popritme.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-4 “Oh! Susanna: the chorus” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Your arrangement
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · title

rows.source: Plan the song
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Een arrangement bepaalt wat je speelt en wanneer. Het jouwe: een intro met Travis picking, de coupletmelodie, het refrein in boom-chick en tot slot de refreinmelodie.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Toonsoort en tempo vóór de melodie aangeven

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Een paar maten akkoorden vertellen iedereen waar thuis is en hoe snel het gaat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Sluit af met de refreinmelodie en laat de laatste G doorklinken. Eindigen met de melodie die iedereen net hoorde voelt afgerond.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-5 “Your arrangement” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: CAGED: five shapes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Elk majeurakkoord kan de greep van open C, A, G, E of D lenen, hoger op de hals. Vanaf elke greep komen ze omhoog in die volgorde, C A G E D, en sluit elke greep aan op de volgende.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
